classes.name: BuzzPhotoController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling Buzz photo retrieval requests, including caching and response preparation.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process incoming requests for a Buzz photo by ID, manage caching, and prepare the HTTP response.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Helper method to set common HTTP headers for the response, including content type and cache control.

methods.name: generateBuzzPhotoETagCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key string for the ETag of a Buzz photo given its ID.
